s1.syndrome_frame: Pelvic mass with chronic lower abdominal pain
salient_findings: Hard, adherent, and painless mass on vaginal palpation
Solid mass located between the uterus and the rectum on transvaginal ultrasonography
Nodular solid mass with enhancing vessels on contrast-enhanced CT
key_facts: 37-year-old woman
Lower abdominal pain for 4 months
Hard, adherent, and painless mass on vaginal palpation
Normal complete blood count
Normal serum electrolytes
Normal creatinine and urea
6.0 × 7.6 × 6.0 cm solid mass on transvaginal ultrasonography
7.4 cm nodular solid mass on contrast-enhanced CT
Attenuation values rising from 20 HU to 70 HU on delayed images
Multiple tortuous enhancing vessels at the periphery of the mass
Mass indents the posterior uterine wall without invasion of adjacent organs
No lymphadenopathy

shortlist.label: Uterine leiomyoma
shortlist.why_kept: Imaging features and location are consistent with a subserosal uterine fibroid

shortlist.label: Cellular leiomyoma
shortlist.why_kept: Similar imaging characteristics to uterine leiomyoma, with a solid mass and delayed enhancement

shortlist.label: Lipoleiomyoma
shortlist.why_kept: Possible given the presence of a solid mass with delayed enhancement and no invasion of adjacent organs

shortlist.label: Symplastic leiomyoma
shortlist.why_kept: Rare variant of uterine leiomyoma, but plausible given the clinical presentation and imaging features

shortlist.label: Aggressive angiomyxoma
shortlist.why_kept: Although rare, this entity is a consideration given the presence of a large pelvic mass with delayed enhancement and multiple tortuous vessels

raw.rationale: The patient's presentation of a hard, adherent, and painless mass, along with imaging features showing a solid mass located between the uterus and the rectum that indents the posterior uterine wall without invasion of adjacent organs, is most consistent with a uterine leiomyoma, particularly given the typical location and characteristics of the mass.

rejected.label: Cellular leiomyoma
rejected.why: While possible, the description does not specifically suggest the high cellularity characteristic of cellular leiomyomas.

rejected.label: Lipoleiomyoma
rejected.why: There is no mention of fatty components within the mass, which is a hallmark of lipoleiomyoma.

rejected.label: Symplastic leiomyoma
rejected.why: The description lacks specific features of symplastic leiomyoma, such as bizarre, atypical cells, which are not mentioned in the imaging or clinical findings.

rejected.label: Aggressive angiomyxoma
rejected.why: This condition typically presents with a more infiltrative pattern and is less likely given the well-defined mass and lack of described infiltration into surrounding tissues.
